newsitem.title: USA: Archer Daniels Midland Q2 Dec 31 net off.
newsitem.headline: Archer Daniels Midland Q2 Dec 31 net off.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q2 results include security transaction gains of $0.02/shr vs $0.08 a year ago. Data adjusted for five percent stock dividend in September 1996.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q2 net includes gains from security transactions equal to $0.02 a share vs gains equal to $0.08 a share in the same period last year.
Per share results adjusted for five percent stock dividend in September 1996.

1996 six months net includes gains from security transactions equal to $0.05 a share and a charge equal to $0.32 a share for fines and litigation settlements arising from U.S. Justice Department antitrust investigation of the company's lysine and citric acid products as well as resolution of a securities suit brought by shareholders.
1995 six months net includes gains from security transactions equal to $0.08 a share and a gain from the sale of the company's Supreme Sugar subsidiary equal to $0.02 a share.
Provision for federal and state income taxes for the six months totaled $172.4 million vs $200.4 million last year.
Full name is Archer Daniels Midland Co.
